hypothesis: The while loop condition in 'findWrapPos' uses 'pos <= text.length()' which allows 'pos' to reach 'text.length()'. prediction: Changing the loop condition from 'pos <= text.length()' to 'pos < text.length()' will prevent the index out of bounds error by ensuring the character access is always within the valid range [0, length-1].

reasoning_summary: The defect is a classic boundary condition error in a loop predicate. This falls squarely under the 'Checking' category as it involves an incorrect conditional check.
